changes: Includes all accepted v3.5.34 reliability, updater, Downloads ordering, TMDB attribution, localhost hardening and Watch Folder fairness work.
Fixes the Windows installer upgrade path so the signed-in-user tray companion is closed before file-lock discovery.

Reworks the tray context-menu path to use the documented foreground-window plus TPM_RETURNCMD pattern and adds an explicit WM_CLOSE/Exit path.
Keeps the tray context menu responsive by avoiding a synchronous backend status request before the menu is displayed.
Builds and validates the complete Windows Setup and Portable artifacts without creating or publishing a GitHub release.
